new.intent: Calculate the exact integer ticket price plus fees for all current bags when the applicable tables assign numeric fees and every checked bag is accepted.
new.procedure:
def apply(inputs, premises):
    total = int(inputs["ticket_price"])
    lengths = inputs["bag_lengths"]
    widths = inputs["bag_widths"]
    heights = inputs["bag_heights"]
    weights = inputs["bag_weights"]
    carry_limits = sorted(inputs["carry_on_dimension_limits"])
    base_fees = inputs["checked_base_fees"]
    standard_size = inputs["standard_checked_linear_size"]
    standard_weight = inputs["standard_checked_weight"]
    weight_uppers = inputs["overweight_upper_bounds"]
    weight_fees = inputs["overweight_fees"]
    size_uppers = inputs["oversize_upper_bounds"]
    size_fees = inputs["oversize_fees"]
    carry_used = False
    checked_index = 0
    for i in range(len(weights)):
        dims = sorted([lengths[i], widths[i], heights[i]])
        fits_carry = dims[0] <= carry_limits[0] and dims[1] <= carry_limits[1] and dims[2] <= carry_limits[2]
        if fits_carry and not carry_used:
            carry_used = True
        else:
            base_index = min(checked_index, len(base_fees) - 1)
            base_fee = base_fees[base_index]
            weight_fee = 0
            if weights[i] > standard_weight:
                for j in range(len(weight_uppers)):
                    if weights[i] <= weight_uppers[j] and weight_fee == 0:
                        weight_fee = weight_fees[j]
            linear_size = lengths[i] + widths[i] + heights[i]
            size_fee = 0
            if linear_size > standard_size:
                for j in range(len(size_uppers)):
                    if linear_size <= size_uppers[j] and size_fee == 0:
                        size_fee = size_fees[j]
            total = total + base_fee + max(weight_fee, size_fee)
            checked_index = checked_index + 1
    return {"answer": int(total)}

(A) during the calendar year or the preceding calendar year paid wages of $20,000 or more for agricultural labor, or

(B) on each of some 10 days during the calendar year or during the preceding calendar year, each day being in a different calendar week, employed at least 5 individuals in employment in agricultural labor for some portion of the day.

(i) during the calendar year or the preceding calendar year paid remuneration in cash of $20,000 or more to individuals employed in agricultural labor (including labor performed by an alien referred to in subparagraph (B)), or

(B) such labor is not agricultural labor performed by an individual who is an alien admitted to the United States to perform agricultural labor pursuant to sections 214(c) and 101(a)(15)(H) of the Immigration and Nationality Act.
(11) service performed in the employ of a foreign government (including service as a consular or other officer or employee or a nondiplomatic representative);
